Historical full-card image of [[Polarized Negative Power Coupling (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Remastered 2006)|Polarized Negative Power Coupling]], matching the [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]] publisher slip. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.
